agenda_items.section: CALL TO ORDER AND ROLL CALL
agenda_items.title: CALL TO ORDER AND ROLL CALL
agenda_items.outcome_summary: Mayor Appelbaum called the meeting to order in Council Chambers.

agenda_items.section: CALL TO ORDER AND ROLL CALL
agenda_items.title: 2012 National Kids to Parks Declaration - May 19th, 2012 is the 2nd annual National Kids to Parks Day to empower kids to enjoy our parks and the outdoors, to broaden their appreciation for outdoor activities thereby combating medical problems such as childhood obesity.

agenda_items.section: CALL TO ORDER AND ROLL CALL
agenda_items.title: YWCA Boulder Day Declaration - May 15th, 2012 was declared YWCA Boulder Day. YWCA was founded on this day in 1922. The YWCA provides many social services, advocacy and empowerment programs and racial justice initiatives.
agenda_items.outcome_summary: May 15th, 2012 was declared YWCA Boulder Day.

agenda_items.title: OPEN COMMENT and COUNCIL/STAFF RESPONSE
agenda_items.outcome_summary: There being no further speakers Open Comment was closed.

agenda_items.title: CONSENT AGENDA
agenda_items.outcome_summary: Council approved Consent Agenda items 3A through 3J, 8:0.

agenda_items.title: CONSIDERATION OF A MOTION TO APPROVE THE FEBRUARY 21, 2012 COUNCIL MEETING MINUTES.
agenda_items.outcome_summary: Council approved this item as part of Consent Agenda items 3A through 3J; the motion carried, 8:0.

agenda_items.title: CONSIDERATION OF A MOTION TO ACCEPT THE MAY 1ST, 2012 STUDY SESSION SUMMARY ON THE FINANCIAL UPDATE AND 2013 BUDGET DEVELOPMENT.
agenda_items.outcome_summary: Council approved this item as part of Consent Agenda items 3A through 3J; the motion carried, 8:0.

agenda_items.title: CONSIDERATION OF A MOTION TO APPROVE THE EXCHANGE OF APPROXIMATELY 1.95 ACRES OF OPEN SPACE LOCATED AT 6800 COAL CREEK DRIVE, KNOWN AS THE SUPERIOR ASSOCIATES OPEN SPACE, FOR 1.65 ACRES OF LAND OWNED BY GERALD AND KEILA DePOORTER. THIS IS A DISPOSAL OF OPEN SPACE LANDS PURSUANT TO SECTION 177 OF THE BOULDER CITY CHARTER.
agenda_items.outcome_summary: Council approved this item as part of Consent Agenda items 3A through 3J; the motion carried, 8:0.

agenda_items.title: CONSIDERATION OF A MOTION TO ADOPT A RESOLUTION APPROVING AND AUTHORIZING AN APPLICATION FOR A GREAT OUTDOORS COLORADO LOCAL PARKS & OUTDOOR RECREATION PLANNING GRANT.
agenda_items.outcome_summary: Council approved this item as part of Consent Agenda items 3A through 3J; the motion carried, 8:0.

agenda_items.title: CONSIDERATION OF AN AMENDMENT TO THE 28TH STREET FRONTAGE ROAD CONNECTIONS PLAN TO REMOVE A PORTION OF SIDEWALK ADJACENT, ON THE SOUTH, TO THE PROPERTY AT 950 28TH STREET.
agenda_items.outcome_summary: Council approved this item as part of Consent Agenda items 3A through 3J; the motion carried, 8:0.

agenda_items.title: SECOND READING AND CONSIDERATION OF A MOTION TO ADOPT ORDINANCE No. 7844 APPROVING SUPPLEMENTAL APPROPRIATIONS TO THE 2012 BUDGET.
agenda_items.outcome_summary: Council approved this item as part of Consent Agenda items 3A through 3J; the motion carried, 8:0.

agenda_items.title: CONSIDERATION OF A RESOLUTION AMENDING THE 2012 DOWNTOWN COMMERCIAL DISTRICT FUND (FORMERLY CAGID) BUDGET.
agenda_items.outcome_summary: Council approved this item as part of Consent Agenda items 3A through 3J; the motion carried, 8:0.

agenda_items.title: CONSIDERATION OF A RESOLUTION AMENDING THE 2012 UNIVERSITY HILL COMMERCIAL DISTRICT FUND (FORMERLY UHGID FUND) BUDGET.
agenda_items.outcome_summary: Council approved this item as part of Consent Agenda items 3A through 3J; the motion carried, 8:0.

agenda_items.title: SECOND READING AND CONSIDERATION OF EMERGENCY ORDINANCE No. 7845 ADOPTING SUPPLEMENT No.112, WHICH CODIFIES PREVIOUSLY, ADOPTED ORDINANCE NOS. 7824, 7827, 7831, 7833, AND 7834 AND OTHER MISCELLANEOUS CORRECTIONS AND AMENDMENTS, AS AN AMENDMENT TO THE BOULDER REVISED CODE, 1981.
agenda_items.outcome_summary: Council approved this item as part of Consent Agenda items 3A through 3J; the motion carried, 8:0.

agenda_items.title: INTRODUCTION, FIRST READING AND CONSIDERATION OF A MOTION TO ORDER PUBLISHED BY TITLE ONLY AN ORDINANCE DESIGNATING THE BUILDING AND PROPERTY AT 950 28 TH STREET, TO BE KNOWN AS THE FIRST CHRISTIAN CHURCH, AS AN INDIVIDUAL LANDMARK UNDER THE CITY’S HISTORIC PRESERVATION ORDINANCE.
agenda_items.outcome_summary: Council approved this item as part of Consent Agenda items 3A through 3J; the motion carried, 8:0.

agenda_items.title: POTENTIAL CALL-UP CHECK IN
agenda_items.outcome_summary: No interest was expressed in the Potential Call-Ups.

agenda_items.title: PUBLIC HEARINGS

SECOND READING, PUBLIC HEARING AND CONSIDERATION OF A MOTION TO ADOPT ORDINANCE No. 7843 DESIGNATING THE BUILDING AND PROPERTY AT 1089 13 TH ST., TO BE KNOWN AS THE FLATIRONS THEATRE BUILDING, AS AN INDIVIDUAL LANDMARK UNDER THE CITY’S HISTORIC PRESERVATION ORDINANCE.
agenda_items.outcome_summary: Council adopted Ordinance No. 7843 designating the Flatirons Theatre Building as an individual landmark, 8:0, Council Member Ageton absent.

agenda_items.title: CONSIDERATION OF RECOMMENDED NEXT STEPS FOR THE CHAUTAUQUA COLLABORATIVE STEWARDSHIP (SUSTAINABILITY) FRAMEWORK
agenda_items.outcome_summary: Two council members George Karakehian and Tim Plass were informally appointed to serve on the committee at Chautauqua.

agenda_items.title: MATTERS FROM THE CITY MANAGER
RECREATION FACILITY PASS PROGRAM FOR VETERANS AND ACTIVE DUTY MILITARY PERSONNEL
agenda_items.outcome_summary: Council received a presentation on the recreation pass program, and Council Member Plass confirmed that this was a wonderful way to thank our veterans.

agenda_items.title: CONSIDERATION OF A MOTION PROVIDING DIRECTION ON OPTIONS FOR REDUCING DISPOSABLE CHECKOUT BAG USE IN BOULDER.
agenda_items.outcome_summary: Council approved direction to develop an ordinance placing a fee on disposable plastic and paper check-out bags at all food stores in the city of Boulder, 7:1, with Council Member Karakehian opposed and Council Member Ageton absent.

agenda_items.title: MATTERS FROM THE CITY ATTORNEY
agenda_items.outcome_summary: None.

agenda_items.title: CITY COUNCIL DISCUSSION AND DIRECTION ON OPEN SPACE WORK PLAN 2012
agenda_items.outcome_summary: Council discussed the Open Space work plan and approved a motion to suspend the rules, 8:0, Council Member Ageton absent.

agenda_items.outcome_summary: There being no further speakers, the Public Hearing was closed.

agenda_items.outcome_summary: Council approved direction to develop an ordinance placing a fee on disposable plastic and paper check-out bags at all food stores in the city of Boulder, 7:1, with Council Member Karakehian opposed and Council Member Ageton absent.
